scope: Focused source inspection, Node syntax, pure reducer, tab-key helper test doubles, template strings and actual module execution against explicit DOM-shaped doubles/fake timers. No browser/DOM implementation.

evidence_boundaries.template_structure: Node VM evaluates only existing template declarations; regex tag/attribute inspection is not DOM parsing or accessibility-tree validation

browser_render_and_input.reason: Recorded preview attempts: installed Playwright has no downloaded browser executable; sandboxed Chromium fails a permitted socket; supported cloud browser localhost returns ERR_BLOCKED_BY_CLIENT. This suite did not retry or bypass those routes.

geometry_and_computed_cascade.reason: No available permitted browser runtime; authored CSS is not measured rendering

screenshots.reason: No rendered capture produced by this suite

assistive_technology.reason: No screen reader or accessibility tree inspected

production_integration.reason: Local authored fixture only; no external service connection

checks.description: Node parses every specimen .mjs without executing its browser bootstrap
Pure reducer and explicit tab-key test-double behavior
Every specimen HTML declares network-disabled, self-only script policy
Specimen code/assets contain no remote URLs or network-commit primitives
Declared local specimen assets and document links exist on disk
Every authored specimen module imports existing local package code only
Generated template strings use buttons for commands, links for navigation, native radio choices and noninteractive meters
All generated IDREF attributes target emitted elements in tested local states
Each tab is selected/focusable exactly once and refers to its consistently present panel
Toggle identity labels remain stable while aria-pressed changes
Busy/exhausted/removed states preserve commands and reference readable local reasons
Treatments generate exactly the same content/roles at matching fixture states
Async callback is epoch-gated and context/reset clear and invalidate the timer
checks.detail: Source guard inspected; no real browser timer or native double-activation was exercised

checks.description: Handlers resolve containing controls and keep native command keys independent of custom tab keys
Actual render module initializes each context/treatment against explicit document doubles
Actual local handlers suppress duplicate start and reject replaced callbacks with fake timers
Actual selection, disclosure/Escape, toggle and resource handlers update local emitted strings
Isolated golf source preserves labels/native roles, IDREFs and scoped candidate inner-face anatomy
checks.detail: Source anatomy only; the final cascade, Korean font pixels, motion and geometry are not measured

checks.description: Actual isolated golf module toggles explicitly simulated local states and activation messages against doubles
checks.detail: Explicit callback/state-property checks only; native disabled input suppression is not modeled or claimed

checks.description: Game tactile translation is authored on the inner face and scoped away from other families
checks.detail: Selector declarations inspected only; target/sibling bounds and final computed cascade remain unmeasured

checks.description: Authored focus, selected, pending and reduced-motion rules remain distinct
Machine-readable contract covers all documented control-role decisions

detail.note: Primary/secondary/tertiary, presentation, hazard and context are separate decisions, not exclusive widget types
